description: This file defines the CartService class which provides business logic for cart operations such as viewing, adding, and deleting items from a shopping cart. It interacts with a cart repository to perform data persistence tasks.

classes.name: CartService
classes.description: A service class for handling cart-related business logic, interfacing with a cart repository to manage cart data.

methods.name: None __init__(self, repository: InMemoryCartRepository | None = None)
methods.description: Initializes the CartService with an optional repository. Defaults to InMemoryCartRepository if none is provided.

methods.name: Dict view_cart(self, cart_id: str)
methods.description: Returns the current state of the cart identified by cart_id.

methods.name: Dict add_item(self, cart_id: str, product_id: str, quantity: int)
methods.description: Adds an item to the cart with specified product_id and quantity, then returns the updated cart.

methods.name: Dict delete_item(self, cart_id: str, product_id: str)
methods.description: Removes an item identified by product_id from the cart and returns the updated cart.

ctags.signature: (self, cart_id: str, product_id: str, quantity: int)

ctags.pattern: /^    def delete_item(self, cart_id: str, product_id: str) -> Dict:$/
